question_text: Outline one privacy concern if a navigation provider supplies identifiable journey histories for training a commercial ML profiling model.
adaptation_rationale: Retains journey-data privacy reasoning but adds explicit ML profiling context; generic location tracking alone does not satisfy emerging-technology ethics guidance.
solution: The histories reveal a person’s routines or sensitive destinations; others can infer home/work or visits the person expected to keep private.

marking_points.criterion: Explains contextual consequence of identifiable journeys.
